UnitStatement: BRIEF_SCHEMA defines the INIT-TASK dispatch contract for TASK + dbm-concordance-verify.
dbm-concordance-verify is used after deterministic package concordance and source-supersession checks produce findings, before DBM_PUBLISHER accepts package readiness.
ScopePath should be the immutable package snapshot directory.
AllowedWriteTargets must exactly name Publication_Concordance_Verification.md and Publication_Concordance_Verification_Findings.csv.
The verification brief must not grant write access to section folders, planning artifacts, KTY folders, or source authority files.
PURPOSE is a required string field explaining why verification is being run.
ScopePath is a required path field naming the package snapshot directory.
TaskSkill is a required string field and must equal dbm-concordance-verify.
AllowedWriteTargets is a required list of paths naming the exact verification outputs.
RuntimeOverrides.SECTIONS_ROOT is a required path to the current section outputs root.
RuntimeOverrides.CONCORDANCE_REGISTER_PATH is a required path to the frozen register.
RuntimeOverrides.CONCORDANCE_FINDINGS_PATH is a required path to deterministic concordance findings.
RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_VERIFICATION_PATH is a required path to the markdown verification output.
RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_VERIFICATION_FINDINGS_PATH is a required path to the CSV verification findings output.
ExpectedOutputs is a required list of paths matching the two verification outputs.
RuntimeOverrides.SOURCE_SUPERSESSION_FINDINGS_PATH optionally names source-supersession findings when validation ran.
RuntimeOverrides.PUBLICATION_RULES_PATH optionally names the approved publication rules.
RuntimeOverrides.PUBLICATION_INPUT_MANIFEST optionally names the frozen manifest.
RuntimeOverrides.PACKAGE_SNAPSHOT_PATH optionally names the package snapshot root.
CustomInstructions is an optional string for run-specific emphasis only.
SECTIONS_ROOT must contain complete current section bundles.
dbm-concordance-verify reads synthesized section outputs only.
dbm-concordance-verify must not be asked to inspect raw KTY-local source files.
SOURCE_SUPERSESSION_FINDINGS_PATH should be provided whenever validate_source_supersession.py ran.
A valid dbm-concordance-verify run requires both Publication_Concordance_Verification.md and Publication_Concordance_Verification_Findings.csv to exist.
All dbm-concordance-verify writes must stay inside the package snapshot directory named in the brief.
Every register key must receive a verdict in the markdown report.
Every blocking verdict must appear in the findings CSV.
dbm-concordance-verify must not modify section outputs, planning artifacts, KTY files, or register files.

Publication_Concordance_Verification_Findings.csv must include AssertionKey, Verdict, Blocking, ImpactedSections, DeterministicFindingRefs, SourceSupersessionRefs, EvidenceRefs, Explanation, and RecommendedAction.
Allowed verification finding verdict values are CONFIRMED, NORMALIZATION_ARTIFACT, SEMANTIC_MISMATCH, IMPLICIT_CONFLICT, OMITTED_REQUIRED_ASSERTION, REGISTER_GAP, and NEEDS_HUMAN_RULING.

Publication_Concordance_Verification.md must contain H2 headings in order: Verification Summary, Per-Key Verdicts, Deterministic Finding Interpretation, Implicit Conflicts, Register Gaps, Human Rulings Required.
SEMANTIC_MISMATCH, IMPLICIT_CONFLICT, and REGISTER_GAP verdicts require explanation with section references.
OMITTED_REQUIRED_ASSERTION verdicts must identify the section, assertion key, and whether the section emitted OMITTED_WITH_RATIONALE, OMITTED_BLOCKING, or no row.
NORMALIZATION_ARTIFACT verdicts must state why the underlying engineering values agree.
NEEDS_HUMAN_RULING verdicts must explain what information is missing or ambiguous.
dbm-concordance-verify uses FAILED_INPUTS when required runtime overrides are missing.
dbm-concordance-verify uses FAILED_INPUTS when the section root, register, or deterministic findings file is missing.
dbm-concordance-verify uses FAILED_INPUTS when output paths fall outside the package snapshot directory.
dbm-concordance-verify uses FAILED when required outputs cannot be written despite valid inputs.
dbm-concordance-verify uses FAILED when semantic verification cannot complete for internal reasons.
The dbm-concordance-verify skill verifies semantic concordance across synthesized DBM section outputs after deterministic concordance checks have run.
The dbm-concordance-verify skill interprets deterministic findings in context and emits a package-local semantic verification report plus findings CSV.
dbm-concordance-verify is a verifier only.
dbm-concordance-verify does not rewrite sections, modify the frozen concordance register, dispatch other workers, or read raw KTY-local source files.
dbm-concordance-verify runs under TASK in generic shell mode with no profile.
DBM_PUBLISHER typically dispatches dbm-concordance-verify during Gate 6 after check_concordance.py and source-supersession validation emit package findings.
Required dbm-concordance-verify inputs are SECTIONS_ROOT, CONCORDANCE_REGISTER_PATH, CONCORDANCE_FINDINGS_PATH, OUTPUT_VERIFICATION_PATH, and OUTPUT_VERIFICATION_FINDINGS_PATH.
Optional dbm-concordance-verify inputs are SOURCE_SUPERSESSION_FINDINGS_PATH, PUBLICATION_RULES_PATH, PUBLICATION_INPUT_MANIFEST, and PACKAGE_SNAPSHOT_PATH.
SECTIONS_ROOT is required and points to a root containing all current SEC-* section output folders.
CONCORDANCE_REGISTER_PATH is required and points to the frozen approved concordance register.
CONCORDANCE_FINDINGS_PATH is required and points to deterministic check_concordance.py findings under the package snapshot.
OUTPUT_VERIFICATION_PATH is required and must name Publication_Concordance_Verification.md under the package snapshot.
OUTPUT_VERIFICATION_FINDINGS_PATH is required and must name Publication_Concordance_Verification_Findings.csv under the package snapshot.
SOURCE_SUPERSESSION_FINDINGS_PATH is unset by default and points to source-supersession findings when validation was run.
PUBLICATION_RULES_PATH is unset by default and points to approved publication rules for restatement and TBD policy context.
PUBLICATION_INPUT_MANIFEST is unset by default and points to the frozen input manifest for admitted-source context.
PACKAGE_SNAPSHOT_PATH is inferred from outputs and points under _Publication/DBM/package/.
dbm-concordance-verify has no deterministic tool requirement and omits allowed-tools.
dbm-concordance-verify must not write outside OUTPUT_VERIFICATION_PATH and OUTPUT_VERIFICATION_FINDINGS_PATH.
dbm-concordance-verify must not modify section outputs.
dbm-concordance-verify must not modify Publication_Concordance_Register.csv.
dbm-concordance-verify must not modify KTY-local files or planning artifacts.
dbm-concordance-verify verifies only synthesized section and package outputs and must not read raw KA or KTY sources.
dbm-concordance-verify outputs a markdown report with one verdict per register key plus summary findings.
dbm-concordance-verify outputs a CSV findings file for package readiness aggregation.
dbm-concordance-verify produces semantic observations for agent and human review.
dbm-concordance-verify does not produce automatic readiness verdicts or blocking decisions.
CONFIRMED means sections agree semantically.
NORMALIZATION_ARTIFACT means an apparent mismatch is formatting or normalization only, not an engineering conflict.
SEMANTIC_MISMATCH means sections disagree on an engineering fact.
IMPLICIT_CONFLICT means section prose implies a value or state that contradicts another section.
COVERAGE_GAP means synthesized sections reveal a potentially material item absent from another section.
NEEDS_HUMAN_RULING means the verifier cannot safely determine agreement without human or domain judgment.
All non-CONFIRMED observations are candidate findings for disposition and do not automatically block readiness.
dbm-concordance-verify first validates inputs and write boundary.
dbm-concordance-verify reads all SEC-##.md, SEC-##_QA.md, SEC-##_ASSERTIONS.csv, and SEC-##_ASSERTION_DISCOVERY.csv files under SECTIONS_ROOT.
dbm-concordance-verify reads frozen control artifacts, including the concordance register, deterministic findings, and source-supersession findings when provided.
dbm-concordance-verify verifies every register key by comparing section prose, assertion rows, omission statuses, and deterministic findings in context.
dbm-concordance-verify interprets deterministic findings by distinguishing real engineering disagreement from normalization artifacts.
dbm-concordance-verify searches synthesized prose for implicit conflicts and register gaps visible in section text or discovery outputs.
dbm-concordance-verify emits fixed outputs and does not rewrite any input.

Publication_Concordance_Verification_Findings.csv must contain AssertionKey, Verdict, Blocking, ImpactedSections, DeterministicFindingRefs, SourceSupersessionRefs, EvidenceRefs, Explanation, and RecommendedAction.
Publication_Concordance_Verification.md must contain Verification Summary, Per-Key Verdicts, Deterministic Finding Interpretation, Implicit Conflicts, Register Gaps, and Human Rulings Required.
dbm-concordance-verify requires no deterministic tools because it reads already-produced package and section artifacts and performs semantic reasoning.
dbm-concordance-verify omits allowed-tools.
dbm-concordance-verify has no operationally invoked deterministic tools.
dbm-concordance-verify uses strong-model semantic reasoning to compare section prose, assertion rows, deterministic findings, and source-supersession findings across the full package context.
dbm-concordance-verify must not invoke publication tools.
dbm-concordance-verify must not dispatch other agents or skills.
dbm-concordance-verify must not read raw KTY-local source files.
dbm-concordance-verify must not rewrite section bodies, section QA, planning artifacts, or the concordance register.
dbm-concordance-verify writes are limited to Publication_Concordance_Verification.md and Publication_Concordance_Verification_Findings.csv.
Both dbm-concordance-verify outputs must resolve under the current immutable package snapshot directory named in the brief.
